title: The Frontier of Spatial Intelligence with Fei-Fei Li & Justin Johnson (a16z Podcast)
summary: World Labs 两位创始人在公司亮相之初讲述从 AI 寒冬、ImageNet 到生成式 AI 的技术脉络与创业动机（2025-11-13 曾随 Marble 发布重播）。核心观点：空间智能是对 3D 世界的感知、重建与生成，是语言模型根本覆盖不了的智能维度，'大世界模型'因此值得与 LLM 平行的投入。

role: World Labs 联合创始人、前密歇根大学教授

While the world has only recently witnessed a surge in consumer AI, our guests have long been laying the groundwork for innovations that are transforming industries today. In this episode, a16z General Partner Martin Casado joins Fei-Fei and Justin to explore the journey from early AI winters to the rise of deep learning and the rapid expansion of multimodal AI. From foundational advancements like ImageNet to the cutting-edge realm of spatial intelligence, Fei-Fei and Justin share the breakthroughs that have shaped the AI landscape and reveal what's next for innovation at World Labs. If you're curious about how AI is evolving beyond language models and into a new realm of 3D, generative worlds, this episode is a must-listen.

Fei-Fei Li 和 Justin Johnson 是 AI 领域的先驱。尽管全球直到最近才目睹消费级 AI 的爆发，但我们的嘉宾早已为如今正在变革各行各业的创新奠定了根基。在本期节目中，a16z 普通合伙人 Martin Casado 与 Fei-Fei 和 Justin 一道，回顾了从早期 AI 寒冬到深度学习崛起，再到多模态 AI 快速扩张的历程。从 ImageNet 等基础性突破到空间智能的前沿领域，Fei-Fei 和 Justin 分享了塑造 AI 格局的重大进展，并揭示了 World Labs 下一步的创新方向。如果你想了解 AI 如何超越语言模型、演进至 3D 生成式世界的新领域，本期节目不容错过。

斯坦福人工智能实验室主任  
Justin Johnson 是 World Labs 的联合创始人  
Martin Casado 是 Andreessen Horowitz 的普通合伙人，负责领导公司的基础设施业务。
